origin.prior_attempt: backtest/lib/patterns/registry.py::engulfing_at_swing_shelf (commit 31c5089e) composed the existing `engulfing` predicate with the existing `flat_side(kind=swing_high/low, n_touches=2)` primitive over crypto.lib.market_structure labeled_swings. VERIFIED via backtest/tools/pattern_anchor_verify.py (commit eea3f423) to NOT fire on either exhibit -- both anchors on that registry rule are honestly declared expected_fire=false.
origin.root_cause_pinned: labeled_swings' pivot confirmation requires `window`=2 bars on BOTH sides of a candidate pivot (crypto.lib.market_structure.DEFAULT_WINDOW / walk_structure's by_confirm lag) before it counts as a confirmed swing. In BOTH exhibits the second touch of the shelf IS the reaction/engulfing bar itself (bar t), which has zero bars after it at evaluation time -- a 2-sided-fractal primitive can never confirm its own trigger bar as a touch in time to fire on it. Every rule composed on flat_side/labeled_swings inherits this blind spot structurally, not as a tuning miss.
origin.new_primitive: backtest/tools/engulfing_at_structure_detector.py::find_shelf_touch -- a ONE-SIDED (backward-only) rolling local-extreme check (is_rolling_extreme: bar i's low/high is the min/max of itself + a short window of PRECEDING bars only). A touch can therefore be confirmed using ONLY bars <= t, including t itself as the second touch. This is the exact primitive queue.md's falsification writeup named as the required next step, not a re-run of the swing-shelf angle.

hypothesis: An engulfing candle (standard OHLC body-containment geometry, body-% floor gated) whose reaction bar sits within a small $ zone-band of a recent rolling-window local extreme (a 'shelf' -- NOT a formally-confirmed swing pivot) marks a tradeable reversal: bearish engulfing at a high-shelf -> put, bullish engulfing at a low-shelf -> call. This is genuinely untested vocabulary -- the 98-cell edge-matrix + 83-cell kitchen matrix tested LEVEL-TOUCH triggers (rejection/reclaim/flip/pingpong/break-retest) and non-level trend vocab; a candle pattern reacting at freshly-formed INTRADAY swing structure (not a named daily level) was never a cell in either.

anchor_falsification_precheck.conclusion: min_bars_apart MUST include 1 for the bearish exhibit to ever be reachable (its only qualifying shelf touch is the immediately preceding bar). zone_band MUST reach 0.15 for the bearish exhibit (0.08 is 1-2 cents short of the real 0.13 spread). The bullish exhibit is comfortably reachable across the whole grid via ITS nearest touch (11:00, spread 0.02) at nbar=1, and via a second farther touch (10:40, spread 0.08) once nbar>=2 excludes the near one -- both are real, both are disclosed, neither is cherry-picked (the runner returns the NEAREST qualifying touch by construction, not a hand-picked one). GRID DECISION: zone_band={0.08,0.15,0.25} (spans below/at/above the bearish exhibit's real spread), min_bars_apart={1,3} (1 = both exhibits' actual touch geometry; 3 = a genuine separation requirement neither exhibit was built to satisfy, included so the grid can HONESTLY show whether requiring more separation helps or just kills the population -- not included to inflate cell count). body_floor={0.50,0.65} unaffected by either anchor (both exhibits' body_pct are 0.77/0.80, comfortably clearing both) -- included because the FULL population's engulfing bars will not all be this decisive; this axis is the honesty check for whether looser bodies still work or just add noise.

axis_rationale.zone_band_dollars: Spans below (0.08), at (0.15), and above (0.25) the bearish exhibit's real touch_spread ($0.13) -- picked from the precheck's own arithmetic, not a round-number guess. Matches the existing registry's LEVEL_PROXIMITY_DOLLARS=0.30 family of magnitude (levels-are-zones doctrine: band width is always a pre-reg A/B, never hand-picked to one value).
axis_rationale.body_floor_pct: 0.50 = a bare majority-body decisive candle (Bulkowski-adjacent minimum for 'meaningful' engulfing per TA-PATTERN-REFERENCE.md sec D candlestick preface). 0.65 = J's own live read of the bearish exhibit ('the most decisive candle of the window', ~0.77-0.80 actual) rounded down slightly to leave room for near-anchors.
axis_rationale.min_bars_apart: 1 = the ACTUAL touch geometry of both real exhibits (immediately-preceding-bar retest). 3 = a genuine-separation contrast cell, disclosed in advance to show whether requiring more space between touches helps or just kills the population -- not added post-hoc.

detector_definition.signal_bar: A fully closed 5m bar t, evaluated with bars <= t ONLY (C6). engulfing_at_structure_detector.detect_bar reads opens/highs/lows/closes[<=t] exclusively; find_shelf_touch searches strictly backward from t-min_bars_apart. Guard test asserts mutating bars after t leaves the result at t unchanged.
detector_definition.engulfing: Standard OHLC body-containment geometry (cur body fully contains + exceeds prev body; cur green + prev red for bullish, mirrored for bearish) -- same math as backtest/lib/patterns/predicates.py::engulfing.
detector_definition.shelf: A ONE-SIDED rolling local extreme (is_rolling_extreme, backward-only window of EXTREME_SIDE_WINDOW=2 bars, structural constant not swept) found within SHELF_LOOKBACK_BARS=12 bars (structural constant, ~60min, not swept) of t, at least min_bars_apart bars before t, whose own extreme sits within zone_band dollars of bar t's own extreme (t itself is NOT required to independently be a local extreme -- see detector module docstring for why that would reject the real 07-21 exhibit).
detector_definition.direction_match: bearish engulfing pairs ONLY with a HIGH shelf (kind='high') -> put side; bullish engulfing pairs ONLY with a LOW shelf (kind='low') -> call side. Structural, not a grid axis.
detector_definition.trigger_level: midpoint of (shelf_price, touch_price), rounded to the cent -- the SPY price level exit_manager's structure_stop references (v15.3 chart-stop-primary doctrine).

gates_passed of 4: [tuning total_pnl > 0] [day majority: winning days > covered days / 2] [survives ex-top-1: total minus single best trade > 0] [held-out positive: >=1 held-out fill AND held_out_total > 0]
regime_split: half-year + vix_band buckets (disclosure only, no gate)
both_anchors_fire: whether THIS cell's own knob values are among the anchor_falsification_precheck cells that fired on both real anchor bars (cross-reference, not re-derived)
ship_criteria: A cell is a SHIP CANDIDATE only if: gates_passed == 4 of 4 AND bh_significant == true AND both_anchors_fire == true AND n_real_fills >= 15 (OP-16 advisory evidence floor, labeled not gated). Firing on the anchors alone ships nothing -- it is a necessary, not sufficient, condition (task's own explicit instruction). If NO cell clears this bar, the result is reported as an HONEST NULL naming the exact binding gate(s) that failed for the best-performing anchor-passing cell(s) -- no post-hoc grid loosening to catch the 2 exhibits.
